test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hardly had I called him ______ my mother started screaming.
solution:
The correct answer is **"When".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **When:** We use **when **to mean **"at the time that"**. We can use **"when" **to tell the **time**. We can use "when" to ask for information about what **time something happens**.

 
 
• **Example:** *Dipali had a great time **when **she went to a picnic spot.*
 
 
 
• "**Hardly.....when**" structure is used ​to refer to something happening immediately after something else. 
 
• We move hardly to front position and invert the subject and verb.
 
 
• Example: **Hardly **had I arrived there **when **I was called back to the head office 100 miles away.
 
 
 
• SO, the correct word to fill in the blank is "**when**".

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete Sentence__: *Hardly had I called him __**when**__ my mother started screaming.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

__
 
• **Then: "Then"__**__ means **"that time"**, **"at that time"**, or **"at the time mentioned" **as in the following sentences__.

 __
 
• **Example: ***The show starts at 6:00, but I'll be home before** then.***
 
 
 
• So: We use 'so' as a subordinating conjunction to introduce clauses of result or decision__.
 __
 
• Example: *It was a long journey, so__ I'm really tired.*
 
 
 
• Than: __It is a conjunction used in the comparison__.
 
 
• Example: *Sheena is taller than me.*
